recommendation: Keep this commit as-is. It completes the intended FHIR-39715 correction in the active references page without changing contained-resource resolution semantics beyond the approved XPath fix.
issue_request: FHIR-39715 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and reported that the contained-resource reference guidance XPath on references.html#contained tested Resource/@id instead of Resource/id/@value. The resolution required changing the example to use f:id/@value; the later Jira comment explains that adding a FHIRPath example was not useful because resolve() handles those details internally.
initial_application: Commit 38aa93e3461d8c449438335c18a74054987993e1 initially applied the issue by replacing the @id predicate in source/references.html with f:id/@value. That same commit accidentally dropped the wildcard node tests after f: and f:contained/, leaving the XPath fragment as ancestor::f:[...] and f:contained/[...].
additional_context: source/fhir.ini maps the Reference datatype page to references, so source/references.html is active current-build source. The Reference datatype invariant in source/datatypes/reference.xml already uses f:id/@value for local contained-reference resolution. Zulip context from the reporter and FHIR-I Confluence minutes support the Jira interpretation and do not broaden the required edit.
reconciliation: Changed source/references.html to restore ancestor::f:* and f:contained/* around the corrected f:id/@value predicate. No FHIRPath prose was added because the Jira follow-up comment rejected that as unnecessary.
source_changes: source/references.html: Restored the missing wildcard steps in the contained-resource XPath fragment.
